utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I think it was that red-cover mystery? And yes, please remind me of the meeting day too, so I don’t miss it again.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but I’m curious — did the book club pick the next read yet?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I think we did pick one, but I’m blanking on the title again. If you’ve heard anything, Nell, I’d love the reminder—and the meeting day too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Not yet, but we’re narrowing it down. I’ll let you know as soon as we pick one.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out. If you want, I can suggest a couple lighter books too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be great, Noah — a couple lighter options would help. I’ll keep you posted once we narrow it down.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thursday evening still works for me — bring a couple gentle, easy-to-finish picks and we’ll choose one.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll bring a couple of gentle, easy-to-finish picks on Thursday evening, and we can choose one together.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect — see you Thursday evening, then.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can help with that. We’ve got "The Book of Goose" for this month, and I can also remind you of the meeting day so you can make it on time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, thanks — that works for me. What day are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We’re still setting the exact day, but I can help pin it down — what days usually work best for everyone?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, we’re still meeting for book club this Thursday, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, still on for Thursday — I can help pull together a quick shortlist if that makes deciding on the next novel easier.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming — a shortlist would be really helpful.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, they picked a mystery this time—pretty twisty one, from what I heard. If you go, bring your best guesses!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—what’s the title and when are we meeting? Once I have the book, date, and time, I’ll mark it down.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I don’t have the title on me, but I can ask around and get it for you. I do know they’re meeting Thursday evening—I'll text you once I confirm the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: We’re reading a mystery novel this month—pretty twisty so far. I can send you the title if you want.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, please — send me the title, and I’ll keep track of where it’s available so we can lock in the next pick.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll send you the title, and if you spot where it’s available, that’ll make things easy for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I was thinking we could keep it light this time—maybe a short, gentle novel everyone can finish without much pressure. I can bring a couple of suggestions to the next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good to me—short and gentle works. Bring the suggestions, and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, I will. I’ll bring a couple of easy options next time, and we can pick whatever feels simplest for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thursday evening works for me too — what time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thursday evening sounds good to me. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 6:30 works for me — does that time fit you too?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep it simple, pick a short book, and let the book club folks know. Once everyone’s in the loop, we can set a time.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds great, Vik — a short book makes this easy to start. Want to suggest a couple of titles, and I’ll help us set the time once we hear back?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll suggest a couple of short titles and share them with the group. Once everyone’s heard back, we can pick a time together.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I don’t think we picked one yet. Want me to check the notes, or should we choose from where we left off?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Let’s choose from where we left off—I’ll keep it simple and send everyone the date, time, and book once we decide.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — what titles are still on the table?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sure — just send me the date, time, and where we’re meeting, and I’ll know if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m a bit late — I’ll grab the date, time, and location and send them over right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Dane — that would help a lot. Once I have the date, time, and location, I’ll know if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, a mystery sounds fun—thanks for telling me. I’m still not sure I can make it this week, but I’d love to hear which one they picked.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in the same boat—I’d like the date, time, and meeting place before I commit. Once Rey hears back, can you send me the details too?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — once I hear back, I’ll pass the date, time, and place along to you too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We’re liking the mix of humor and mystery so far — it’s a fun read to discuss. If you want, I can bring my copy and a couple of notes next time.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That sounds good — just to confirm, we’re still on for the book club tonight, right?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, we’re still on for tonight — same time and place. I’ll bring my copy and the notes so we can pick up right where we left off.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, they picked a mystery this time—pretty twisty one, from what I heard. If you go, bring your best guesses!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Nice, I love a twisty mystery. If you want, I can help you and the book club come up with a shortlist of good follow-up reads after this one.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be lovely, Jules! A shortlist would make it way easier to keep the club buzzing after this mystery.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes — just to confirm, it’s this Thursday at 6:30 at the library, and we’re discussing "The Garden Between Stars," right?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, that’s right — Thursday at 6:30 at the library for `The Garden Between Stars`. I’ll repeat that to the others and keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate you keeping everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can check the notes if you want, or we can pick back up from the last meeting and decide now.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: We’re reading a mystery novel this month—pretty twisty so far. I can send you the title if you want.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, please send the title—I’ll add it to my notes. Do we need to pick a discussion date too?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the book club — did we pick the next book yet? I might’ve missed the latest change.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, I’m a bit late too — what book did we land on, and when are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, I’m not sure we settled it yet — I think we were leaning toward something lighter, but I missed the final pick. Want me to check with the group?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thursday evening works for me too — 6:30 at the library still sounds good.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — Thursday at 6:30 at the library it is. I’ll send the invite to everyone now so the details are in one place!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thank you — that should help everyone stay on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure — I can help with that. We’re reading “The Book of Goose,” and I can pull together a couple date and book options if you want.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’d be great, Mara—thank you. A couple of dates and one or two gentle options would really help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll bring a couple of date options and a couple of gentle book picks, and I’ll keep the reminder handy too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—just send me the book and time, and I’ll mark it down.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m not sure we settled on a title yet—want me to check the notes and get back to you with the book and time?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes please—just check the notes and send me the book and time, and I’ll put it on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, great — I’m still hearing bits and pieces, so I’d love the update when you all decide. Thanks for keeping me in the loop!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Absolutely — we’re leaning toward a short, easy read for Thursday evening, and I’ll let you know as soon as we pick one.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Perfect, that sounds right up my alley — I’ll keep an ear out for the pick. Thanks, Leo!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’d be great, Mara — please bring a few book and date options, and we’ll narrow it down together.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll bring a few shortlist options with where each book’s available, and then we can pick a date that works.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Opal — that’ll make it easy to choose. Mara, once we see the options, we can pick the best match and set the date around it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — we’re reading *The Book of Goose*, aren’t we? I’d love the meeting day too, if you’ve got it handy.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, that sounds right — send me the meeting day when you can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks — I’m blanking on the day again, so send it my way when you get a chance. I’ll try to be on time for once.
